title: Support Fn-wheel zoom on Response Board
outcome: Allow Response Board zoom with Fn plus mouse wheel when the browser exposes the Fn modifier, while preserving Ctrl-wheel/pinch zoom and ordinary unmodified scrolling behavior. Add focused UI coverage and rebuild the served bundle.
acceptance: On master, a Response Board wheel event zooms when ctrlKey is set or the browser reports the Fn modifier (getModifierState('Fn')), and an unmodified wheel event is not intercepted.
UI tests on master cover Fn-wheel zoom, an unmodified wheel left unhandled, and ctrl-wheel zoom around the cursor.
docs/features/response-board.md states Fn-wheel zoom and that it depends on the browser exposing the Fn modifier.

completion.summary: Verification-only closure. Fn-wheel zoom on the Response Board, delivered by f6e766d8 (an ancestor of master 1495e8d3). response-board-camera.ts zooms on ctrlKey or getModifierState('Fn') and leaves unmodified wheels alone. ResponseBoardPanel tests cover Fn, unmodified and ctrl-wheel. response-board.md documents the Fn dependency. Independent evaluation 3cb4cdd4 passed 3/3.
